nn: Til lukke, ven! For ei velsigning.
Lova vere Gud! Godt gjort!

en: So happy for you. God is good!
nn: Så glad på dine vegner. Gud er god!

en: Congratulations! I'm thanking heaven for you.
nn: Gratulerer! Eg takkar himmelen for deg.

en: Well done, good and faithful friend!

en: Glory be! So proud of you.

en: Faithful in little, faithful in much!

en: You sowed, and now you reap. Well done!
